# IEEEtran

`IEEEtran.cls` v1.8b and `IEEEtran.bst` v1.14 (26 August 2015) were retrieved
from canonical CTAN on 1 November 2026:

- https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/IEEEtran/IEEEtran.cls
- https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/IEEEtran/bibtex/IEEEtran.bst

Their original copyright/license notices are retained. These standard style
files do not certify compliance with current journal-specific requirements.
The earlier TMLR template remains for original-preprint provenance but is not
loaded by the revised manuscript.
